app.name: profs
app.tagline: The gradebook that stays on your device

workspace.title: Schools
workspace.help: Each school has its own classes, pupils and gradebooks. Switch schools from the menu.
workspace.name: School name
workspace.confirmDeleteBody: Its pupils, marks and gradebooks are erased for good.

dashboard.noClasses: No classes yet. Create one with “Add a class” — everything else starts there.
dashboard.noGradebooks: No gradebooks yet. Create one with “New gradebook” to start grading.
dashboard.gradebookPeriodsHint: The gradebook is created with three terms; you can rename them or add more from the gradebook itself.
dashboard.gradebooksNeedClass: A gradebook pairs a class with a subject. Add a class above first.
dashboard.gradebooksNeedSubject: A gradebook pairs a class with a subject. All you are missing is a subject, created in Settings.

class.noStudents: No students in this class. Add them one by one with “Add student”, or paste your list with “Import CSV”.

class.rosterFull: This class has reached {{max}} pupils: no more can be added.

group.name: Group name

group.confirmDeleteBody_other: Its {{count}} pupils will no longer be grouped, but stay in the class.

gradebook.calcEmpty: No data to calculate from yet

gradebook.confirmDeletePeriodBody: Its columns and all their marks go with it.
gradebook.noPeriods: This gradebook has no period left. Add one before you can create columns in it.
gradebook.none: No gradebook for this class yet.

settings.backupHelp: Export your data as JSON to move it to another device. Student photos are not included.
settings.importOverCapacity: Import refused: this file contains a class of more than {{max}} pupils.

settings.wipeHelp: Permanently deletes every piece of data in this workspace on this device. This action cannot be undone.
settings.wipeConfirmBody: This school's pupils, marks, gradebooks and seating plans are erased for good.
settings.noSubjects: No subjects yet. Add one — a gradebook pairs a class with a subject.
settings.subjectInUse_one: The subject “{{name}}” cannot be deleted: {{count}} gradebook still uses it.
settings.subjectInUse_other: The subject “{{name}}” cannot be deleted: {{count}} gradebooks still use it.

settings.subjectInUseSessions_other: The subject “{{name}}” cannot be deleted: {{count}} lessons still use it.
settings.themeHint: The choice stays on this device.
settings.termStartHint: Used to work out A and B weeks. Without this date, lessons in week A or B are not shown.

csv.overCapacity: Untick {{excess}} row(s): the class would exceed {{max}} pupils.

layouts.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}” and the arrangement in it

plan.noRoom: No room in this school yet. Create one before you can seat your pupils.

today.needsTermStart: Lessons in week A or B need a start-of-year date:

schedule.subject: Subject
schedule.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
schedule.overlapWarning: Clashes with: {{lessons}}. You can save anyway.

diary.title: Journal
diary.empty: Nothing written for this period. Pick a day and note what you did.

recovery.title: profs could not open its data

retry.body: The database did not open, but your data is intact. Reload the page. If it keeps happening, close any other profs tabs and try again.

unsupported.body: This browser is refusing the local storage profs needs, which is common in a private window. Open the app in a normal window, then reload.

quota.body: There is not enough space left to open this school. Free some up, or delete this school's data to reclaim what it was using.

corrupt.body: This school's data cannot be opened. Try reloading first: if the error returns, deleting this school's data is the only way to get the app open again. That deletion is permanent.

recovery.discardConfirmBody: Its marks, pupils and gradebooks are erased. The school comes back empty, under the same name.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.help: A room belongs to the school. Each class taught in it keeps its own seating plan.
rooms.name: Room name
rooms.empty: No rooms yet. Create one — this is where the tables live, and your classes come to sit at them.
rooms.confirmDeleteUsedBody: {{classes}} will lose their seating plan, and the tables go with the room.
rooms.emptyRoom: This room has no tables. Tap “Table”, then tap the floor to put one down.
rooms.pickShape: Pick a starting layout — everything stays editable afterwards.

seance.confirmDeleteBody: Its attendance and behaviour go with it.
